# Giga Atom — Space Leaf Corp

Created by Leif William Sogge  
Proprietary Research — Nonprofit Planetary Benefit Only

## Overview

The Giga Atom is a digital-first atomic model designed in cyberspace and simulated using advanced stability, bonding, and gyroscopic frameworks.  
This repository contains the full simulation suite, analysis tools, and documentation for safe, ethical research.

## Mission

This project exists to:
- Advance safe nanoscale research
- Explore digital atomic architectures
- Support nonprofit planetary benefit
- Prevent misuse, weaponization, or harmful applications

## License

This project is governed by the **Space Leaf Corp Proprietary License 1.0**.  
Unauthorized use, redistribution, or weaponization is strictly prohibited.  
All profits derived from this work must be donated to the Space Leaf Corp nonprofit initiative.
